prompt_text: Who is the best healthcare marketing agency in St. Louis?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single objectively “best” healthcare marketing agency in St. Louis — the right choice depends on your specific goals, budget, patient types and services. I can help you find the best fit. To get you started, here’s a practical way to evaluate and narrow choices quickly.

Key questions I need to know
- What kind of healthcare organization are you? (hospital system, urgent care, specialty clinic, private practice, med device, pharma, behavioral health, etc.)
- Which services do you need? (brand strategy, web design, SEO, paid media, content, patient acquisition, physician outreach, PR, internal communications, digital patient experience, analytics)
- Budget range (monthly or campaign)?
- Timeline and geography requirements (must be local St. Louis agency or okay with remote/agency outside the city)?
- Any regulatory/compliance priorities (HIPAA, state-specific rules, patient privacy)?

How to choose an agency (practical criteria)
- Healthcare experience: proven case studies with organizations like yours (patient acquisition, retention, rebranding of a clinic, etc.)
- Compliance knowledge: HIPAA, FTC, state advertising rules and clinical claims management
- Measurable outcomes: examples of KPIs improved (new patient volume, appointment conversions, cost-per-lead)
- Digital capabilities: SEO, site conversion optimization, paid search/social, CRM/EHR integration, telehealth promotion
- Creative + strategic balance: strong storytelling for patient trust + hard metrics focus
- References & reviews: client references and third-party review sites (Clutch, Google, LinkedIn)
- Team stability & local presence: local market knowledge can matter for referral networks and community outreach
- Reporting & transparency: clear metrics, dashboards, and communication cadence

Where to look for candidates
- Clutch.co and DesignRush (filters for healthcare, location, reviews)
- Google Maps and LinkedIn (search “healthcare marketing agency St. Louis”)
- Local healthcare marketing associations or St. Louis business directories
- Ask peers in the St. Louis health system space for referrals

Interview questions to ask agencies
- Tell me about two healthcare clients similar to us and the specific outcomes you achieved.
- How do you handle HIPAA and patient-data-related campaigns?
- What metrics will you use to measure success? How often do you report?
- What is your experience integrating marketing with EHR/CRM and appointment systems?
- Can you share a campaign that didn’t work — what did you change?
- Who will be on our account team and how often will we meet?

KPIs to require in proposals
- New patient appointments / month
- Cost per acquisition (CPA)
- Website conversion rate (appointments / visits)
- Organic search ranking improvements for priority terms
- ROI on ad spend (when using paid campaigns)

Next steps I can do for you
- If you tell me the type of organization, budget and services you need, I can draft a short RFP and a prioritized shortlist template you can use to evaluate 3–5 St. Louis agencies.
- Or I can create an outreach email template for contacting agencies and a scorecard to compare proposals.

Which would you like me to do — draft an RFP and shortlist template, or make a list of candidate agencies (if you give me permission to look up current options)?
